title: SNOOZE text inside the snooze button is not responsive
symptom: The SNOOZE text inside the snooze button is not responsive, likely due to layout issues on certain phone screens. The user reports that with AndroidAPS 3.0-rc1 on a Poco F3 with text size set to L, the snooze button text appears cut off or not properly displayed.
cause: The issue is a layout problem, not a functionality issue. The maintainer suggests it may be due to small screens and asks if rotating to landscape helps, but the user confirms it persists. The maintainer then commits a fix.
fix: The issue was improved by a commit: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/72e73f604f124ea08d3dc0a06a6765dbe9fe4899
